preparation.title: Festival preparation photograph
preparation.body: A red paper crane and a white ribbon mark desk 17. The other decorations are blue. Desk numbers 12, 17 and 31 are visible.
preparation.reverse:
15 October 1999. Festival committee.
Aya Ito: classroom decorations.
Keep the desk lids clear until cleanup.

original.title: The small original photograph
original.body: Sakiko sits at a desk holding scissors. She has just looked up. Her expression is reserved. She is not smiling.

folded.title: Folded note from the student bag
folded.body: Take it down before she sees it.

sketch.title: Art packing list F-12
sketch.body:
PACKING DRAWER: F-12 MATERIAL
Original photograph and collection access envelope.

Open the labeled flat drawer at the packing station. The collection key admits the upstairs exhibition and archive reading room.

display.title: The enlarged festival portrait
display.body: An enormous cardboard head hangs above the attraction. The enlarged photograph has uneven dark eyes and a grotesque smile painted over the mouth. Strings support the cardboard. Black strips trail below it.
display.reverse:
F-12 / Oversized portrait
Committee envelope: ARCHIVE BAY B3, COMPARTMENT 12.

A small brass key is fixed inside the rear document sleeve.

recording.title: Festival recording transcript
recording.body:
Student A: F-12 is packed. Leave the equipment case in the AV room.
Student B: What is the combination?
Student A: The festival date. Month, then day. Same as the program.
[Two faint knocks.]
Student B: Did someone stay behind?
Student A: I thought you checked.
[Handling noise. Recording stops.]

account.title: A handwritten account
account.body:
I gave the key to you after cleanup.
You said you were going back.
Please stop saying we all forgot.

Equipment return: U08 rehearsal access key is in case B2. The scenery inventory report is stored in G09.

plan.title: Scenery shelving maintenance plan
plan.body:
G09 SCENERY INVENTORY

The report sleeve is behind the rolling shelf. Lift its visible brake, then slide the shelf left along the short floor rails. Keep the travel path clear.

The report concerns former rehearsal room U08 upstairs. Its ordinary access key is kept with AV equipment, in case B2.

letter.title: Sakiko’s undelivered letter
letter.body:
Could I help in the library next year instead?
I know the festival needs people.
I would rather do something where nobody has to look at me.

belongings.title: A discarded festival tag
belongings.body:
YUI KANDA
SCENERY / FINAL CLEANUP

Personal papers and the old student bag were left in rehearsal room U08.
Do not discard them with the backdrop material.

class_photo.title: A class photograph
class_photo.body: A class photograph from autumn 1999. Sakiko stands near the left edge, a little apart, behind a classmate’s shoulder. Her expression is reserved.

notice.title: School notice
notice.body:
18 October 1999

We regret to inform families of the death of student Sakiko following an accident in a restricted scenery storage room.

Festival activities are suspended. Please direct inquiries to the school office.

inventory.title: Festival inventory
inventory.body:
15 October 1999

3 mounting decorations
1 hanging frame
1 oversized portrait
1 scenery-room key

Return borrowed equipment to shelf B2.

destroy.title: A later message
destroy.body:
Please destroy the old festival photographs.
I do not want another copy turning up.
Ask the others as well.

maintenance.title: Caretaker’s maintenance sheet
maintenance.body:
FORMER REHEARSAL ROOM U08
Scenery inventory report

16 October 1999

08:40  Room opened.
Student found shortly afterward. Police notified.

18:10  Returned to secure room.
Knocking heard [u]inside[/u].

handover.title: Staff handover slip
handover.body:
Night handover

The cabinet service key is in this desk drawer. Collect the upper-wing key and festival storeroom key from the wall cabinet. Both stair doors use the same upper-wing key. AV and scenery storage share the festival storeroom key.

loan.title: AV equipment loan slip
loan.body:
MIKA ENDO / EQUIPMENT

Recording FEST-99-10-15 is stored in BROADCAST U05 upstairs. Use the local playback breaker.

Case B2 remains in AV G05 downstairs. The recording custodian describes how its combination was set.

envelope.title: Aya Ito festival envelope
envelope.body:
Aya Ito / committee envelope
Entrance key I.

Upper-wing and festival storeroom keys are on the lower cabinet shelf. The collection access envelope remains in the art packing drawer.

exhibit.title: Exhibit F-12 inventory label
exhibit.body:
F-12 / CULTURE FESTIVAL 1999
Oversized portrait / Ken Sato

Inventory paperwork retained on the reverse of the mounted panel.

archive_record.title: Ken Sato committee envelope
archive_record.body:
B3-12 / Ken Sato

Committee envelope: entrance key II, F-12 festival cassette, media-room key and dated festival program.

Sakiko sat in classroom 2-B. A narrow red ribbon marked her exercise book. Her ordinary class photograph is still there.

program.title: Dated festival program
program.body:
CULTURE FESTIVAL
15 OCTOBER 1999

Exhibition committee / equipment returns
AV case B2: festival date, month then day.

tape_index.title: Broadcast recording index
tape_index.body:
BROADCAST / U05

FEST-99-10-15
Festival equipment and cleanup recording
Custodian: Mika Endo

Local breaker supplies this playback deck only.

case_reference.title: Scenery report reference
case_reference.body:
Equipment return / B2

Entrance key III and old rehearsal-room access key.
The incident report is filed behind the mobile scenery rack in G09. Release its brake and slide along the floor track.
